name: algorithm-transfer-v1
description: Six further public algorithm tasks with English symptom/mechanism and explicitly bilingual fingerprints; 24 new paper/repository identities. Sources and implementation links were checked against public paper metadata, author pages or repositories. Snippets are independent concise summaries, not copied full abstracts. Topic relevance is authored; original v1 sources are additional unjudged distractors. This is a transfer development fixture, not blind or live-provider evaluation. Public source availability is not an open-source license determination.
